rewards: Ability to use Ardougne teleport spell and tablets

st.t: Talk to Edmond in the north-west corner of East Ardougne.
Talk to Alrena and give her the dwellberries.
Grab the Picture from Edmond's house.
Talk to Edmond again.
Use four buckets of water on the mud patch in Edmond's garden patch.
Use a spade on the mud patch.
Go down the hole.
Attempt to pull the grill in the south of the sewer.
Use a rope on the grill.
Talk to Edmond and ask him to help you pull off the grill.
Equip the gas mask and climb through the pipe.
Talk to Jethick east of where you emerge.
s: Yes, I'll return it for you.

st.t: Enter the tall house in north West Ardougne.
Talk to Martha or Ted Rehnison
Talk to Milli upstairs.
Try to enter the house in the south-east corner of West Ardougne.
s: I fear not a mere plague.

st.t: Talk to the Clerk in the large building north of the manhole.
s: I need permission to enter a plague house.
This is urgent though! Someone's been kidnapped!

st.t: Talk to Bravek in the room to the east.
s: Do you know what's in the cure?

st.t: Use your chocolate dust on the bucket of milk.
Use the snape grass on the chocolatey milk
Give the hangover cure to Bravek.
Talk to Bravek to receive the warrant you need to enter the plague house.
Try to enter the plague house again.
Search the barrel in the room for a small key.
Go downstairs in the plague house.
Enter the jail and talk to Elena.
Go back upstairs and return to the town square. Go down the manhole, follow the sewer and climb the mud pile, then return to Edmond at his house to finish the quest.
